steps.description: Brainrots walk in from the purple portal on the west end and travel east along the neon belt. Watch a few walk past and read their floating labels: name, rarity, $/s and price.
steps.title: Meet the conveyor

steps.description: Click a walking brainrot to buy it. The cheapest costs $125 and you start with $150, so your first buy is always within reach. Your brainrot walks to your base and starts earning $/s.
steps.title: Buy your first brainrot

steps.description: A tsunami sweeps the island every 3 minutes. Run this step to see one now: hide in your base or at spawn, or get splashed back.
steps.title: Survive the tsunami

steps.description: Click another player's brainrot to steal it home within 20 seconds, lock your own base with LOCK BASE, and spend cash on rebirths (+25% income per level) and upgrades.
steps.title: Steal, lock, rebirth
